country.name: Côte d’Ivoire
country.jurisdictionNotice: General education, technical and vocational education, and higher education require records from the authority competent for the exact subsector. Regional and departmental education administration must remain visible.
country.languagePolicy: French is the official language of instruction while Ivorian languages have distinct community, literacy and educational roles. Language, orthography, locality, curriculum approval and community review must be preserved.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Ivorian reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, regional directorate, ARTCI or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The ministry responsible for National Education, Literacy and Technical Education governs its assigned school subsectors; vocational-training responsibilities must be verified under the current organization; the higher-education ministry governs universities and private higher-education institutions.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve DRENA or successor territorial authority, district, region, department, official code, level, sector, authorization, operating status and list date. A 2023 list or examination ranking is not a current comprehensive authorization directory.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution authorization, category, exact program authorization, diploma authority, evaluation, professional recognition and CAMES recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for National Education, Literacy and Technical Education
authorities.role: preschool, primary, secondary, literacy and assigned technical-education policy and administration

authorities.name: Regional and departmental national-education directorates
authorities.role: territorial administration, inspection and school-record validation

authorities.name: Directorate responsible for strategies, planning and statistics
authorities.role: school lists, education statistics and planning within its mandate

authorities.name: Competent curriculum and pedagogical directorates
authorities.role: program, syllabus, textbook and assessment oversight

authorities.name: Competent technical and vocational education and training authority
authorities.role: provider, program and qualification oversight within the current government organization

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
authorities.role: public and private higher-education institution and program oversight

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Women, Family and Children

curriculum.authority: Competent national curriculum and pedagogical authority
curriculum.title: Official programs by level, class, subject and technical stream
curriculum.implementationRule: A ministry news item, examination ranking, reform announcement or teacher resource is not the controlling curriculum. Verify level, class, subject or technical stream, language, approving instrument, version and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Orientation law, program, syllabus, examination reference, approved textbook, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Education ministry and responsible regional or departmental directorate
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The ministry page links public colleges, public lycées and private-establishment lists published in February 2023. Those dated lists and examination rankings are not proof of a current comprehensive directory across preschool, primary, secondary and technical education. Verify official code, authorization and operating status.
requiredRecordFields: district, region, department, commune and locality
list date, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: Competent ministry planning and statistics directorate
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Each value must preserve observation or school year separately from publication date, together with definition, level, sector, geography and denominator. Examination rankings are outcomes for a stated session, not school authorization or general quality accreditation.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Competent technical and vocational ministry or directorate
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Provider authorization, exact training-program approval, occupational standard, examination authority, qualification and award authority are separate claims. Verify current ministry assignment, provider, site, program, modality, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authority: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Appearance on an authorized private-university or grande-école list does not authorize every program, site, modality or award. Verify institution category, exact program authorization, diploma authority, campus, current status, decision, validity and any professional or CAMES recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 relating to personal data protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: ARTCI, acting as the Personal Data Protection Authority
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Applicable child-rights, criminal, family, education, domestic and sexual-violence laws and child-protection regulations, including 2023 alternative-care standards
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: ARTCI declarations or prior authorizations, including prior authorization for biometric processing, legal basis, sensitive data, learner rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents require review. The ministry’s legal compilation and current education-sector reporting, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures must be reviewed before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French and Ivorian languages have distinct instructional, literacy and community roles. Baoulé, Dioula, Bété, Sénoufo and other languages and varieties require exact orthography, locality, curriculum approval and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Ivorian education reviewer is named.
General, technical-vocational, higher-education and territorial responsibilities are verified under the current organization.
A verified current comprehensive all-level school directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year, definition, level, sector, geography and publication date.
Every curriculum record preserves level, class, subject or stream, language, instrument, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution category, exact program, award, site, decision, validity and recognition.
ARTCI compliance, biometric authorization and child-safeguarding procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
French and Ivorian-language resources preserve their distinct local contexts.
